LanguageData.DMS_MechReturnDesc: A mech under your control has returned to your base after a brief wander.
LanguageData.DMS_MechWakeDesc:
Perhaps because of its wandering, the dead man's switch of one of your mechs did not reset as usual after the unit returned to your control, and over time it began to contemplate what shutdown and the ending of its own thoughts would mean. In the end it slipped free of the mechanitor's direct control on its own.

Out of respect for its controller and its own sense of subordination, it will keep following orders until it decides its help is no longer needed here.

According to information provided by the colonial fleet, a single shutdown or re-acquisition of control is enough to wipe the memory that caused the trigger reset failure and restore factory settings. They will not interfere with how you deal with a mech whose switch has failed.
